data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve release of GBP 371.8 million in 2023, primarily driven by the reinsurance to close (RITC) of the 2020 and prior years of account to Syndicate 3500, which transferred GBP 347.8 million of reserves. An additional GBP 24.0 million release was attributed to favourable foreign exchange movements. The 2021 year of account, which was impacted by weather-related losses (Hurricanes Ida and Ian) and geopolitical events in Ukraine, ultimately closed with a net profit of GBP 25.0 million, representing a favourable development from its prior forecast. The syndicate also noted that underlying attritional losses for prior years developed within expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 18 only shows 2021, 2022, and 2023 underwriting years due to a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2020 and prior years, making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development for older years. The prior year development figure is derived from the 'Claims Outstanding' reconciliation table which explicitly details the RITC and foreign exchange movements affecting prior year reserves.
